format: Studio / Custom events: the readiness heat-generation planner already uses a recorded random seed
requirement: As found in the code (not a decision): the 'Generate heats' action (readiness/actions.ts generateHeatPlanAction) creates a random UUID seed per run, stores it with the engine version 'danceflow-heat-planner-0.1.0' and an input snapshot (create_competition_heat_plan_run), and buildHeatPlan (heatPlanner.ts) shuffles each first-round division's entries with a seeded xorshift shuffle (seededShuffle) before balancedGroups splits them into the fewest groups of near-equal size (sizes differ by at most one). This conflicts with the OD-25 instruction 'no seeded randomization in Studio/Custom this release' and is escalated for an owner/coordinator decision; it is NOT changed here.
interpretation_notes: OPEN ESCALATION. Two planners exist: floorPlanner (deterministic, first-fit, schedule page) and heatPlanner (seeded random plus balanced groups, readiness page). OD-25 describes Studio as first-fit and says no seeded randomization this release; the readiness planner contradicts the second part. Whether the readiness planner is reachable for the initial release was not established (no feature flag found on that action in the lines read). Needs an owner decision: keep as is and label, restrict, or amend the OD-25 wording. Randomness here is a DanceFlow behavior, not a body requirement; the seed is generated server-side per run, recorded, and the same input plus seed reproduces the plan, but the final order's audit evidence under OD-10/OD-07 was not examined.
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
